title: SUIGuard
tagline: SUIGuard gives instant wallet risk scores to detect scams, bots, and fraud on Sui.
description: SUIGuard is a DeFi safety layer on Sui that gives users an instant traffic-light risk score before interacting with wallets or protocols. It helps prevent scams, bots, and suspicious fund flows using fully on-chain public signals, improving trust and usability in the Sui DeFi ecosystem.
how_its_made: SUIGuard will be built as a lightweight DeFi safety layer on Sui. The project will provide a simple web interface where users can paste a Sui wallet address and instantly receive a traffic-light risk indicator before interacting with wallets or protocols. The backend will query public on-chain data through Sui RPC and Explorer APIs, analyzing transaction history, contract interactions, and fund flow patterns. A rule-based scoring engine will be used to flag early warning signals such as scam-linked transfers, bot-like activity, or exposure to high-risk contracts. RiskLight aims to improve trust and usability across the Sui DeFi ecosystem.
